description: Swap a person, object, or background inside the right-clicked video using a reference image. Keeps the original audio.

input_slots.label: Source Video
input_slots.description: The right-clicked video whose content gets swapped.

input_slots.label: Reference Image
input_slots.description: The person/object/background to swap into the video.

keyframe_id.label: Keyframe
keyframe_id.description: Frame index (1..last) used as the swap keyframe.

mode.label: Swap Mode
mode.description: What to swap in the video.

original_sound_switch.label: Keep original audio
original_sound_switch.description: Preserve the source video's audio track.
